cause: A layer boundary was crossed. Almost always repo/ importing handler/ to reach a DTO, or core/domain importing something above it.
steps: Read the cycle the compiler prints: it lists the packages in order, and the wrong edge is usually the last one.
Dependencies point one way: handler -> core/port -> core/domain, and repo -> core/domain. Nothing under repo/ or core/ may import handler/.
If the repository needs a shape the handler defined, the shape belongs in core/domain or core/port, not in handler/.
Move the type; do not add an interface to break the cycle in place — that hides the boundary violation instead of removing it.
watch_out: rules_lint's layer-dto-boundary catches this before the compiler does, and names the exact import.
